description: This file defines the 'ClaimExpenseDecorator' class, which provides utility methods to decorate and manipulate 'ClaimExpense' entities within the OrangeHRM system, including setting related claim requests and expense types, and formatting dates.

classes.name: ClaimExpenseDecorator
classes.description: A decorator class for ClaimExpense entities, providing methods to associate claim requests and expense types, as well as date formatting functionalities.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the decorator with a specific ClaimExpense entity.

methods.name: setClaimRequestByRequestId
methods.description: Associates a ClaimRequest with the ClaimExpense based on a request ID.

methods.name: getClaimRequestById
methods.description: Retrieves a ClaimRequest entity given its ID.

methods.name: getClaimService
methods.description: Returns an instance of ClaimService for accessing claim-related operations.

methods.name: getClaimExpense
methods.description: Returns the current ClaimExpense entity being decorated.

methods.name: setExpenseTypeByExpenseTypeId
methods.description: Sets the expense type of the ClaimExpense based on an expense type ID.

methods.name: getDate
methods.description: Formats and returns the date of the ClaimExpense in Y-m-d format.
